subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub keep a post-publish GitHub Release repair workflow, replace it with a tested release-only mode, or intentionally retire that recovery path?
rationale: The PR removes a CODEOWNERS-covered release recovery workflow, and source inspection shows the remaining npm publish workflow cannot repair the same post-publish failure mode.

options.title: Replace Repair Path Before Deletion
options.body: Add an equivalent release-only repair path that works after npm has accepted the package, then update docs and tests before deleting the standalone workflow.

options.title: Keep Existing Workflow
options.body: Leave the standalone workflow and runbook in place until release owners decide the recovery path is no longer needed.

options.title: Retire With Owner Acceptance
options.body: Accept the operational tradeoff only if release/security owners document how maintainers recover a failed GitHub Release after npm publish.

recommendation.title: Replace Repair Path Before Deletion
recommendation.body: Add an equivalent release-only repair path that works after npm has accepted the package, then update docs and tests before deleting the standalone workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly routes workflow changes through this release/security automation owner group.
